8.6. iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.pathgen¶

The module defines classes used to generate 3-tuples (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for valid paths in railyard.

Functions

edgeCount(layout) Calculate the edge cost of the layout, i.e.

Classes

CostEdges(railyard) Return an object that is used to generate the path-tuple (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for each path in a railyard that starts from and ends in nodes with the degree not equal to 2.
DirObj2DirObjPaths(railyard[, noPrefix, …]) Return an object that is used to generate the path-tuple (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for each path in a railyard where the node of startNodeIndex contains a directed object and the node of endNodeIndex also contains a directed object.
DirObj2EndPaths(railyard[, noSuffix, …]) Return an object that is used to generate the path-tuple (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for each path in a railyard where the node of startNodeIndex contains a directed object and the node of endNodeIndex contains an end object.
DirObj2NodePaths(railyard[, noPrefix, …]) Return an object that is used to generate the path-tuple (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for each path in a railyard where the node of startNodeIndex contains a directed object.
End2DirObjPaths(railyard[, noPrefix, …]) Return an object that is used to generate the path-tuple (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for each path in a railyard where the node of startNodeIndex cntains an end object and the node of endNodeIndex contains a directed object.
End2EndPaths(railyard[, noPrefix, noSuffix, …]) Return an object that is used to generate the path-tuples (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for all paths in a railyard that start from and end in end nodes (of which the degrees are 1).
NegativePaths(railyard[, noPrefix, …]) Return an object that is used to generate the path-tuples (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for all paths in a railyard whose orientations are negative (not positive).
PathGenerator(railyard[, noPrefix, …]) Return an object that is used to generate 3-tuple (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex), referred to as X{path-tuple} for each valid path of a railyard.
PathHull(railyard, startNodes[, endNodes]) Return an object that is used to generate the path-tuple (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for each path in a railyard that starts from a node belonging to startNodes and ends in a node belonging to endNodes.
PositiveEdges(railyard[, noPrefix, …]) Return an object that is used to generate the path-tuples (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for all positive paths in a railyard that starts from and ends in nodes whose degrees are not equal to 2.
PositivePaths(railyard[, noPrefix, …]) Return an object that is used to generate the path-tuples (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for all paths in a railyard whose orientations are positive.
StraightCostEdges(railyard[, noPrefix, …]) This class is deprecared and will be removed.
StraightEnd2EndPaths(railyard[, noPrefix, …]) Return an object that is used to generate the path-tuple (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for each straight path in a railyard that starts from and ends in end nodes.
StraightPaths(railyard[, noPrefix, …]) Return an object that is used to generate the path-tuple (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for each straight path in a railyard.
